skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concepts, characteristics, and roles of tax.
Understand the components and criteria of an optimal tax system.
Understand the principles and content of tax management.
Understand the basic contents of consumption taxes.
Understand the basic contents of income taxes.
Understand the basic contents of current tax management.
Apply methods to calculate the amount of consumption tax to be paid.
Apply methods to calculate the amount of income tax to be paid.
Analyze achievements and limitations in tax management and propose solutions.
Establish critical thinking in evaluating tax management issues.
